recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6251 unless Patient Care separately wants editorial cleanup of the article in Communication.payload.content[x], which is outside the semantic scope of this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-6251 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care change request. It said Communication.payload.content[x] was too narrow because it only described multipart messages, and it requested changing the definition to "The communicated content (or for multi-part communications, one portion of the communication)" with the same change on CommunicationRequest.
initial_application: Commit a452682b2ad0328e1dec9b63685546719904daf2, whose subject included #6251, changed both Communication and CommunicationRequest spreadsheet definitions from "An individual message part for multi-part messages" to the broader wording requested by the issue. Later source refactors carried the content into the current StructureDefinition XML inputs.
additional_context: Communication and CommunicationRequest are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current Communication.payload.content[x] definition says "A communicated content (or for multi-part communications, one portion of the communication)." The current CommunicationRequest.payload.content[x] definition says "The content (or for multi-part communications, one portion of the communication) to be communicated"; that prospective wording was a later FHIR-38783 decision applied by commit fa35c0d85eb81ae4a3adc9de5c5cd75f201280f7. FHIR-20770 later added CodeableConcept payload support and explanatory comments to the same payload family without narrowing the FHIR-6251 definition.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already conveys that payload content is communicated content generally, or one portion of a multipart communication, and no current source location still uses the old multipart-only definition. Reverting CommunicationRequest to the exact 2015 wording would undo the later request-tense clarification without improving FHIR-6251 conformance.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Patient Care decision changed CommunicationRequest.payload.content[x] to the prospective "to be communicated" wording, explaining the current difference from the 2015 text.
Later Published Patient Care issue added CodeableConcept payload support and comments to the same payload elements without narrowing the FHIR-6251 definition.
